<!--
THE BAR, and it is the whole point of this template.

A gap belongs here when you can write the "Next invocation" line below. That line is a
naming sentence with a real caller: "X is missing, and the next invocation that needs X is Y."
A gap with no named next invocation is speculation.

If you cannot write "Still open because", you are not filing a gap. You are deferring work,
and the honest move is to build it.

This register exists because a chronological log is written once and read never. The framework
has already paid for trusting one: the v0.32 changelog records a gap that had been found and
filed in this repo's own save log two days earlier and declined, and the next book paid for it
by hand-negating an oil lamp and a clay jar in all 27 of its spreads.

It was a file, docs/GAPS.md, until 2026-09-12. It was retired because a 1,391-line markdown
register decays in ways a file cannot resist: entries ended up both above and below its own
"how to file" section, three numbers were used twice, and nothing could be assigned, closed,
searched or cross-linked. All 50 entries were migrated here as issues carrying their original
ids in their titles, because references across the repo still cite them.
-->
